companyContext: Nike, Inc. is an American multinational corporation headquartered near Beaverton, Oregon, that designs, develops, manufactures and markets athletic footwear, apparel, equipment and accessories. It is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel.
brandContext: Nike Football is Nike's football (soccer) division, producing on-pitch performance gear and off-pitch lifestyle apparel for national teams and clubs — including the French Football Federation (FFF) — blending sport heritage with streetwear codes.

brandVision: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world — uniting the world through sport to create a healthy planet, active communities, and an equal playing field for all. For Off-Pitch Looks France, the vision is to extend the passion of the French national team beyond the stadium into everyday street style.
brandValues: Performance, authenticity, innovation, empowerment, audacity and team pride. The France Off-Pitch capsule celebrates national identity (Les Bleus), self-expression and the football culture that lives equally in the stands, in the street and on the pitch.
